# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old initially  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; Treasurer of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and black, glossy hair. Her cheerful countenance reflects a merry expression inherited from her father.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022)_

## Personality

Diana is a sweet, merry, and loyal companion who laughs easily and frequently. While she does not share Anne's wild poetic imagination, she is practical, good-natured, and dependable. She possesses a firm sense of honor, refusing to act as a telltale or abandon her friends during misadventures.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)_

## Traits

- Merry and cheerful  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- Loyal and honorable  <sub>[v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)</sub>
- Avid reader  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- Fast running ability
- Singing

## Goals

- To be a faithful, lifelong friend to Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>

## History

Upon Anne Shirley's arrival in Avonlea, Diana met her in the Barry garden at Orchard Slope, where the two girls instantly bonded and swore a solemn oath to be lifelong bosom friends. Diana shared in many childhood adventures, playhouses, and schoolroom experiences alongside Anne. During a sleepover at Orchard Slope, Diana and Anne entered a bed-racing contest without knowing her great-aunt Josephine Barry was sleeping in the spare room, causing severe outrage and nearly losing Diana her music lesson funding until Anne personally intervened. Soon after, Anne accidentally served Diana currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Diana to become intoxicated; as a result, Mrs. Barry temporarily forbade Diana from speaking to or playing with Anne until Anne saved Minnie May's life during an attack of croup. When Anne fractured her ankle after falling off the Barry house ridgepole on a dare, Diana frantically rushed to her aid and summoned her father for assistance. As she grew older, Diana joined the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, serving as its treasurer while continuing her close companionship with Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c23 P17](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0017), [v1 c23 P22](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0022)_

- Grew up at Orchard Slope without any sisters close to her age  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>
